name: yxj-paper-os
description: Reader-first, evidence-bound academic paper design and revision with argument-path diagnosis, matched-venue writing calibration, impact closure, and canonical artifact verification.

interface.shortDescription: Reader-first academic paper design and revision.
interface.longDescription: YXJ Paper OS designs or revises one academic paper within a non-negotiable evidence boundary. It enters from a creation baseline or current material delta, builds a reader-evaluable argument, repairs the earliest reader-path divergence, calibrates writing against verified matched-venue exemplars when relevant, closes every affected surface, and proves the canonical rendered artifact matches the current source without rewriting shared Git history.
capabilities: Explicit assess, design, revise, and audit intent
New-paper creation baseline or existing-paper delta re-entry
Reader-first paper contract and argument-unit design
Earliest reader-path divergence and recurrence repair
Matched-venue functional writing calibration from verified exemplars
Non-negotiable scientific evidence boundary with minimal sufficient defense
Repository authority and stable author directions
Claim-bearing figure and table production from editable sources
Direct writeback with cross-surface impact closure
defaultPrompt: Design a reader-first paper argument from the current scientific evidence.
Revise this paper, close affected surfaces, and verify the canonical artifact.
Calibrate this paper against matched-venue exemplars without changing its science.
